H08-02: Inspection and normalization of all UI colors (CSS, inline, JS, Tailwind) to calculate palette size.
Pass: 4 or fewer distinct color groups are detected.
Fail: More than 4 distinct color groups are used on the page.
1. Extract colors from CSS blocks, inline styles, script DOM manipulations, and Tailwind classes.
2. Normalize to hex values. Convert all grayscale/desaturated colors into a single "grayscale-group".
3. Exclude semantic system variables (success, error, warning). Count unique groups.
If more than 4 distinct color groups are detected:
- Consolidate the color palette to use a maximum of 4 distinct accent/brand colors. Note that all grayscale shades are evaluated as a single group.
